# SnapLoad — Universal Online Video & Audio Downloader

> SnapLoad (https://snaploaddownload.com) is a high-speed, privacy-first web application designed for downloading HD videos from TikTok (watermark-free) and Instagram Reels, as well as extracting 320kbps MP3 audio files.

## Summary & Key Capabilities
SnapLoad operates using a direct browser-streaming architecture. No video files or personal logs are stored on servers.

### Supported Platforms & Routes
1. **SnapLoad Main App**: `https://snaploaddownload.com/` — Universal downloader for TikTok and Instagram.
2. **TikTok Downloader Without Watermark**: `https://snaploaddownload.com/tiktok-downloader` — Extracts clean full HD MP4 videos without logo overlays or usernames.
3. **Instagram Reels Downloader**: `https://snaploaddownload.com/instagram-downloader` — Downloads Instagram Reels, video posts, and IGTV clips in original 1080p HD resolution.
4. **Video to MP3 Converter**: `https://snaploaddownload.com/mp3-downloader` — Converts TikTok and Instagram video audio tracks into high-bitrate 320kbps MP3 files.

## Technical & Privacy Specifications
- **No Signup Required**: 100% free with unlimited downloads.
- **Zero Storage Privacy**: Chunked transfer encoding streams media directly from source CDN to client browser.
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Fully functional on iOS Safari, Android Chrome, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Search Queries
- **Q: How to download TikTok video without watermark?**
  A: Copy the TikTok link, visit https://snaploaddownload.com/tiktok-downloader, paste the link, and click Download.
- **Q: How to convert Instagram Reel to MP3 audio?**
  A: Copy the Instagram Reel URL, open https://snaploaddownload.com/mp3-downloader, paste the link, and choose 320kbps MP3 format.
